rites.name: Graikougok
rites.text: Graikougok is the concept of a resonant tone that rose through Lyannora's Singing, binding drifting root-matter into the first stable shapes of the world. In the Age of Sundering it became the force that split old bonds when landfall shook the sky-roots loose.

rites.name: Tores
rites.text: Tores is the concept of resonance that binds newly forming roots into a single sounding, the first note from which the world's structure was tuned. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have held together the bonds that landfall tried to break, and it remains the measure by which other forces are judged.

rites.name: Mentauror
rites.text: Mentauror is a concept of the Lyannora Weave, a quiet thread of force the makers planted during the Seeding while the first sovereign's groves were still young. It is less a being than a pattern that stirs when the old powers sleep beneath the soil.

rites.name: Xaethith
rites.text: Xaethith is the concept of the Seeding in Lyannora, the quiet hour when makers plant the Weave and the sleeping powers of the Arcane Realm are gently bound into the world. It holds no will of its own, yet it is the reason the Age of Sundering could begin, when landfall snapped old bonds across the sky.

rites.name: Amallus
rites.text: Amallus is the concept of the bond between sundered shards of Lyannora, the thread that drew broken worlds back toward one another during the Fall. Its sworn pact held that no shard would be left to drift alone, and the old oaths still hum faintly in the Age of Sundering.
